summary.text: This concurrent resolution expresses the sense of Congress that Congress and the President should examine and support ways to expand access to contraceptives.

title: Expressing support for the recognition of September 26, 2025, as "World Contraception Day" and expressing the sense of the House of Representatives regarding global and domestic access to contraception.
